proof_attempt_summary: Discovery delivered informal matched absolute-risk and finite-honest connected-length rates n^-1/5 observationally and n^-1/2 under supplied randomization, including full-Uniform-support converses and a boundary-uniform moving-order expansion. Independent math and decision reviews passed, but the narrow affine-centered class and enormous finite calibration limited the completed package to incremental, below the field floor. Reaching field requires a broader-class or practical-calibration research program; no F-stage Lean formalization, axiom audit, or certification was performed.
tldr: For pairwise discordance of benefit and harm CATE rankings, the completed matched minimax results are \(R_n(\mathcal M)\asymp H_n(\mathcal M)\asymp n^{-1/5}\) and \(R_n(\mathcal M_R)\asymp H_n(\mathcal M_R)\asymp n^{-1/2}\), with no additional logarithmic factor and an exact order price \(n^{3/10}\) for rough observational adjustment. The projected covariance correction, boundary-uniform moving-order expansion, total finite computation and calibration, and full-support hidden-shear mixture are proved ingredients. Explicit data-only estimators and connected intervals attain these orders with coverage at least \(0.90\) at every finite \(n\ge2\); matching same-class converses cover arbitrary randomized Borel procedures. The public full-Uniform square, affine-centered \(C^3\) effect neighborhood, and binary cell floor define a narrow subfield precision benchmark for comparing benefit and harm effect-score strata, without a claim of clinical realism.
gap: Pointwise CATE minimax theory and expected-conditional-covariance precision do not directly evaluate the discordance of two unknown effect rankings. A support-dependent pointwise lower experiment cannot certify the stipulated full-support converse. Regression-shape rank comparison supplies motivation and consistency, while exact finite-sample connected uncertainty requires additional work. Classical observed-rank asymptotic inference in Pohle, Wermuth and Wei\ss\ addresses a different experiment from learning both causal score surfaces with finite-sample uniform honesty.
fill: The frontier question demands evaluated all-sample-size risk and length sequences, total computable attainers, public calibration, same-class arbitrary-procedure converses, and the two observational penalties. The moving-order question tests the geometric spine before estimator assembly. The benefit-harm ordering consumer concerns separate therapeutic and adverse effect models followed by common score strata; the benchmark quantifies fitting uncertainty without assuming those data satisfy the stipulated model.
